intensity ▯▯▯
Grammar stays fixed, material changes. Damage travels out and bursts; heals flow in; buffs rise; debuffs sink; a Barrier is a boundary; removal locks on, then destroys. Each faction draws that grammar in its own material and sound: Cortex: lasers, pixels, circuits, clean square-wave blips Aegis: molten shrapnel, hex plates, scorch, metal clangs Swarm: spores, chitin, goo, tendrils, wet chitters Null: glitch bars, rifts, vortex, dark stars, broken pitch Neutral: light rays, glints, runes, bells.
Wards. Rares call their faction's single-ring ward only for a signature attack, buff or defence, then it vanishes. Every Mythic carries its own permanent, one-of-a-kind ward, behind the card (only the parts reaching past the card's edges show, so its art and stats stay readable) that also acts out its ability: Quorum Arbiter lights a seat for each enemy unit (its attack), Prime Aegis tethers and shields its allies, Hive Mother beats like a heart and sends larvae to her brood, Null Singularity bends the grid and drags pointers into itself. A Mythic's ward flares for its signature moves and shatters when it dies.
Music is generated live like the effects: A minor at 104 BPM. It starts calm (pad and bass), and every hit, kill and Mythic raises the intensity, bringing in kick, arpeggio, hats and snare. It settles again over a few seconds. The arpeggio takes the acting faction's voice, a Mythic on your side adds a bell motif, and effects dip the music only slightly so it never drops out.
Magnitude scales debris, shake, hit-stop and volume. A kill freezes for a beat, splits colour at the edges, punches the camera in and leaves scorch and debris on the table for a few seconds.

Fallback ward for a brand-new Mythic

When a new Mythic is created and Replicate cannot be reached, code builds a one-of-a-kind ward from the card's name and faction. The same name always produces the same ward. Type a name and put it on the board in place of your Mythic.
